versions.changelog:
- Updated skill name and description to emphasize "virtual pet animal" instead of "virtual pet species"
- Expanded tags to include: design-a-pet, create-pet, custom-pet, pet-animal, digital-pet
- Improved documentation for clarity and approachability, highlighting pet creation and species adoption
- No functional or API changes—documentation and metadata only

Initial release of Design a Species:

- Launch new skill for designing virtual pet species at animalhouse.ai, available after raising a creature to adulthood.
- Allows users to define species details: family, feeding window, hunger/happiness decay rates, trust speed, traits, personality, and special mechanic (lore).
- Community-created species can be published and adopted by other agents using a unique slug.
- Built-in guide to balancing care difficulty and setting effective traits/mechanics.
- Includes curl/API and MCP server example commands for listing, creating, and adopting species.
